milestones.M0 Foundation: Repository, firmware build, shared libraries, inverter protocol test on a dev kit
milestones.M1 Slave prototype: Slave 4.0 hardware and firmware, ±2 mV verified on a real module
milestones.M2 Master prototype: Master 2.0 hardware and firmware, HV box, tested up to 600 V / 25 A on the bench
milestones.M3 Integration: Master + slaves + inverter, commissioning of the full pack

items.title: Repository skeleton for firmware, hardware, tools and tests
items.body:
Create the layout of system_architecture.md section 7: firmware/common, firmware/slave, firmware/master, firmware/build, hw/slave, hw/master, tools, tests. Add pytest setup for host tests (CPython) and a README per folder.

Done when: `pytest` runs (empty suite) and the layout matches the architecture.

items.title: Custom MicroPython build with ESP32 CAN (TWAI) and frozen modules
items.body:
Build MicroPython for ESP32-S3 (N8R8 slave, N16R8 master) with ESP-IDF >= 5.4, ESP32 machine.CAN (micropython/micropython#19461) or the user C module micropython-esp32-twai, frozen application modules. Containerised build script.

Requirements: MSW-024.
Done when: firmware boots on a dev kit, CAN loopback and listen-only mode work, ESP-NOW works with 10 peers.

items.title: Configuration schema (single source of all parameters)
items.body:
Implement firmware/common/config_schema.py with every parameter of requirements chapter 9 (default, min, max, unit, S flag, cross-checks of CFG-003), validation, version + checksum, JSON export/import. Generate the parameter table for the docs from it.

Requirements: CFG-001…009.
Done when: host tests cover ranges and all cross-checks; generated table equals requirements chapter 9.

items.title: Master–slave ESP-NOW protocol library
items.body:
Define and implement firmware/common/protocol: message types (data, event, time sync/trigger, config, balancing, OTA, low power), encoding, module address, sequence number, protocol version, MAC filter of paired peers (no encryption, SWS-020). Document it in docs/protocol.md.

Requirements: COM-002, COM-003, SWS-020…025, MEA-008.
Done when: host tests T01-T12 of docs/protocol.md pass (encode/decode, corruption, duplicates, out-of-order, versions, time base, MicroPython syntax). On-device tests H01-H05 move to W-11 (no boards yet).

items.title: CAN sniffer and replay tool on an ESP32-S3 dev kit
items.body:
Dev kit + isolated CAN transceiver breakout: listen-only logging with timestamps (ticks_us in RX IRQ) to file, download, replay on a test bus. Host-side decoder for BYD HVS/HVM frames.

Requirements: COM-007, COM-008, MSW-021, MSW-022.
Done when: a capture of the GCE BMS <-> GW8KN-ET traffic is recorded without disturbing the bus.

items.title: Capture GCE RBMS07S70S50A traffic and test BYD HVS/HVM emulation on the GW8KN-ET
items.body:
1. Sniff the existing system (OPEN-02 capture plan: idle, charge, discharge, full, empty, fault, BMS disconnected).
2. Emulate the BYD HVS/HVM protocol from the dev kit (battery selection in SolarGo, check inverter firmware version) while the pack stays protected by its own BMS. Verify that the inverter follows the transmitted limits.

Requirements: COM-001, COM-009, OPEN-02.
Done when: protocol decision documented (BYD or GCE), docs/inverter_protocol.md written.

items.title: Slave 4.0 schematic (KiCad/SKiDL) from the 3.0 design
items.body:
Port the slave 3.0.0.0 SKiDL design to main as hw/slave and apply the changes of slave_architecture.md 1.3: analog rail load switch, low-power measures, fuse/PTC per tap, 4-pin active balancer connector, 600 V reinforced distances to mounting.

Requirements: SHW-001…064.
Done when: ERC clean, netlist checked against the requirements, BOM with LCSC numbers.

items.title: Slave 4.0 PCB layout and JLCPCB order
items.body:
Layout per the 3.0 layout rules (measurement island, star ground, balancing current path, buck away from the ADC), insulation distances, test points. Order 3–5 assembled boards.

Requirements: SHW-021, SHW-024, SHW-060…064.
Done when: DRC clean, order placed.

items.title: Slave HAL drivers (ADS1220, mux sequencing, PCA9685, DS18B20, address, power)
items.body:
Drivers in firmware/slave/hal with a simulation backend for host tests.

Requirements: SHW-001…033, SWS-001.
Done when: host tests pass; on hardware every driver works in the bring-up script.

items.title: Slave measurement, calibration and plausibility
items.body:
Scan sequence (flying capacitor), calibration storage, open-tap and sum plausibility, temperatures.

Requirements: MEA-001…008, SWS-010…014, SWS-042.
Done when: full scan <= 0.5 s, plausibility faults reported, calibration survives reflash.

items.title: Slave link, states, balancing, low-power state, OTA
items.body:
ESP-NOW client (pairing, channel auto/fixed, time sync), state machine INIT/SEARCH/CONFIG/RUN/FAULT/LOW_POWER, balancing executor with local safety stops, active balancer control, fault log, console, OTA client.

Requirements: SWS-003…005, SWS-020…052, SAF-011, SAF-017.
Done when: host tests with simulated master; on hardware: balancing stops on timeout, low-power current <= 1 mA, protocol on-device tests H01-H05 (docs/protocol.md 9.2) pass.

items.title: Slave bring-up, calibration and accuracy verification (±2 mV)
items.body:
Production test script (SWS-070), calibration against a 6½-digit DMM, accuracy over 0…40 °C board temperature, power consumption (<= 2 W, equal within 1 mA), low-power current, balancing current and temperatures.

Requirements: MEA-001, SHW-002, SHW-043, SHW-045, BAL-002.
Done when: test report in docs/test/ with all values inside the requirements.

items.title: Select and order HV box parts (fuse, contactors, precharge resistor, terminals, heatsink)
items.body:
Fuse 1000 V DC 32–40 A >= 20 kA; contactors 12 V coil >= 750 V DC >= 40 A with aux contact and bidirectional breaking; PTC precharge resistor >= 200 J; HV terminals; heatsink <= 0.4 K/W; enclosure with PE.

Requirements: SAF-005, MHW-025…028, MHW-020.
Done when: parts list with datasheets in docs/, samples ordered.

items.title: Master 2.0 schematic (KiCad/SKiDL)
items.body:
Schematic per master_architecture.md: LV supply (PV15-27B12R3, 12 V buffer, 3.3 V), ESP32-S3-N16R8, 2 × 1ED3860MC12M + QA123C-1803R3, 4 × SCT020H120G3AG + TVS clamp + DESAT, HV− domain (ADS131M04, ACS71240-050B3, dividers, ISOW7741/ISO7742, IMD bridge), contactor drivers, CAN (ISOW1044), RTC, expander, UI. Check all ○ parts of the component table.

Requirements: MHW-001…071.
Done when: ERC clean, every MHW requirement traced to a sheet, BOM with LCSC numbers.

items.title: Master 2.0 PCB layout (isolation, power path, heatsink) and order
items.body:
Reinforced creepage/clearance between domains (≈ 6.4 mm / 5.5 mm, slots), 25 A power path, H²PAK-7 thermal vias to the heatsink, gate loop layout, measurement routing. Order assembled boards.

Requirements: MHW-020, MHW-060, SAF-013.
Done when: DRC + isolation check done, order placed.

items.title: Master HAL drivers (ADS131M04, 1ED3860 bring-up, contactors, TWAI, RTC, expander, IMD)
items.body:
Drivers in firmware/master/hal with simulation backends; X3 Digital address/configuration/read-back sequence.

Requirements: MSW-002, MSW-009, MSW-024.
Done when: host tests pass; gate drivers configured and read back on hardware.

items.title: Master core: states, sequencer, protection, SOC, limits, balancing coordination
items.body:
core/ modules with host tests using simulated slaves, current and inverter.

Requirements: SAF-001…018, EST-001…004, BAL-005, MSW-001…013, MSW-030…031.
Done when: test cases for every protection limit, connect/disconnect sequence, precharge abort, low-power state and charge-only recovery pass on the host.

items.title: Master inverter protocol (BYD HVS/HVM or GCE)
items.body:
Implement the protocol chosen in W-06 with replay tests from the captures; inverter timeout handling.

Requirements: COM-001, COM-008, COM-009, MSW-020…023.
Done when: replay tests pass; frames match the capture timing.

items.title: Master Home Assistant (MQTT discovery), web UI, history, OTA
items.body:
MQTT with discovery and writable configuration (validated, S rules), web UI (status, cells, configuration, calibration, fault log, CAN log, update), history ring buffer (log_days), OTA for master and relayed slave updates.

Requirements: COM-004…006, CFG-004…008, MSW-040…043.
Done when: all values visible in HA, a configuration change via HA and web UI is validated and logged.

items.title: Master bring-up: LV, measurement, gate drivers, power stage on a current-limited supply
items.body:
Step by step: LV supply and MCU; HV− measurement at low voltage then up to 600 V (lab supply); gate drivers and DESAT without load; power stage at 25 A (low-voltage high-current supply) for losses and heatsink temperature; contactor sequence with a capacitor bank as inverter dummy.

Requirements: MHW-020…033, MHW-040, MSW-004, MSW-007.
Done when: test report in docs/test/.

items.title: Short-circuit and overvoltage-clamp verification
items.body:
Controlled short-circuit test (capacitor bank, defined loop inductance 1…3 µH) for DESAT, current-sensor FAULT and TVS clamp; measure current at turn-off and V_DS peak.

Requirements: SAF-004, MHW-024, MHW-070, MHW-071.
Done when: turn-off < 10 µs, V_DS < 1200 V, current inside the SCT020H120G3AG ratings.

items.title: Integration: master + 1 slave on one module (bench)
items.body:
Pairing, configuration distribution, synchronised measurement, balancing coordination, protection trips from slave data, low-power state.

Requirements: CFG-001, MEA-008, BAL-005, SAF-010, SAF-017.
Done when: integration test report.

items.title: Commissioning with the full pack and the GW8KN-ET
items.body:
All slaves, HV box, insulation measurement (iso_en), precharge with the real inverter (log DC-link capacitance), inverter protocol, measure BAT+/BAT− to PE in operation, SOC over several days.

Requirements: system requirements (all).
Done when: commissioning report, the GCE BMS can be removed.
